AI/ML mentorship at VIT

As a Senior Core Member of RoboVITics, I led computer science project initiatives and mentored a student AI/ML team of more than 100.

My role

I helped guide AI/ML work in the RoboVITics Club at Vellore Institute of Technology. The role combined project leadership with hands-on support for students building and evaluating models.

Mentorship focus

I mentored the team through model building, evaluation and deployment. That experience made technical communication and practical decision-making as important as code.
